exposure: High-risk group (placenta previa or anterior low-lying placenta and at least one previous Cesarean delivery)
Presence of the separation sign on ultrasound
outcome: Normal spontaneous placental separation at delivery
cohort: Pregnant women at risk for PAS referred to a specialist clinic between 22 and 38 weeks' gestation.
finding: A positive separation sign on ultrasound was a reliable predictor of normal placental separation at delivery, even in women at high risk for PAS.
